# SHANXING Custom PVC Shoe Charms
> Factory-direct custom soft PVC shoe charms from Fujian, China for brands, retailers and promotional buyers.

SHANXING is Shishi Shanxing Plastic Products Factory (石狮市山行塑料制品厂), Room 203, No. 16, Lunhou 1st District, Bao'gai Town, Shishi City, Fujian Province, China. Its house brand is MOCHI CHARMS: https://mochicharms.com/

## Main pages
- [Custom PVC Shoe Charms Manufacturer](https://arismemo.github.io/pvc-shoe-charms-factory/): MOQ, budgetary volume pricing, factory process, quotation inputs and contact details.
- [PVC Shoe Charms Sourcing Guide](https://arismemo.github.io/pvc-shoe-charms-factory/guide.html): materials, mold coordination, production, report scope, samples, packing and shipping.

## Key commercial facts
- Standard starting MOQ: 100 pieces per design.
- Published prices are budgetary EXW Fujian assumptions, not a final quotation: 100–499 pcs per design $0.30/pc; 500–1,999 $0.20; 2,000–4,999 $0.15; 5,000+ $0.10.
- Mold fee: $30–80 per design, waived when a single design reaches 5,000 pieces.
- Mold, sample, special packing, testing, shipping, duties and taxes are quoted separately unless stated otherwise.
- Mold manufacturing is handled by specialist partners; shoe-charm production and quality checks stay in the SHANXING factory.
- Supplier material test reports are available for scope review; finished-product or batch testing may still be required.
- Samples from 3 working days after artwork and mold details are confirmed; after sample approval, bulk production takes about 7–10 days for under 5,000 pieces and 12–15 days for 5,000–50,000 pieces.
- Shipping: about 5–7 days by air, 25–35 days by sea; freight is quoted to the destination.
- Payment: molds and samples before work starts, sample fee credited against the bulk order; bulk orders 50% deposit, balance before shipment.
- Free design proof within one working day: Send your artwork and within one working day we send a proof sheet showing how the charm will look, its size in millimetres, the number of colors and the backing position. It is free and you do not need to place an order first.
- Sample policy: Samples from our ready series are free; you pay the shipping. Custom samples carry the mold fee and the sample fee, and the sample fee is credited against your bulk order.
- Quality promise: Free artwork revisions until you approve. If the bulk charms do not match the approved sample, tell us within 14 days of delivery with photos, and we remake the pieces that do not match and ship them to you at our cost.
- Phthalate-free soft PVC is used for charms that children will wear.
- Customer artwork is used only for that customer's orders and is not sold or shown without permission.
- Sales to businesses only, from 100 pieces per design; no single-piece dropshipping.
- Replies within one working day.
